name: json
description: JSON reading and writing behind the engine's own interface

name: logging
description: Records, the Logger, sinks, the JSON lines format and the fatal path's last write

name: trace
description: Spans: the per-thread stack, parents, timing and the path, written as logging records

name: asset
description: Asset ids, the catalog Data Contract, the loader interface, whole-file reading and the text loader

name: audio
description: The audio mixer, its shared immutable clips and the sound loader

name: image
description: Images in one pixel layout (RGBA8, top row first) and the png loader behind stb_image

name: model
description: Models as CPU data (nodes, materials, skinned meshes, clips), sampling, blending and retargeting poses, and the fbx loader behind ufbx that declares the textures as images

name: voxel_map
description: The chunked voxel map a tool bakes (the index and its regions): reading, validating and expanding into world-space geometry and boxes, and the loaders of both

name: entity_ids
description: The default entity allotter: RangeAllotter registered in every World with a default range

name: world_time
description: Game time in a World: time Resources, the fixed step, the tick

name: world_logging
description: The World end of logging: Forward and the Kernel diagnostics a runner takes

name: rollback
description: Putting a World back to an earlier step and running it again: the public registrations and the strategy interface

name: authority
description: Who decides the state of the game, chosen per World as a strategy: the registrations of decision data, the server authority strategy, the consistency fingerprint and the digest

name: world_asset
description: The World end of asset: the Product's AssetStore, AssetRequests and AssetView in every World, the apply System

name: state_machine
description: A World's global states: the current value, requests, enter and exit schedules, sub-states and run conditions

name: save_version
description: Save versions: the current version and the oldest one a load takes, checked by the author's load

name: http
description: A small HTTP/1.1 client: the request's bytes, an answer read as it arrives, one call polled on a StreamSocket

name: net
description: The network: the Link (UDP and in memory), the transport (acks, two channels, fragments, drop counts), the handshake and liveness, the Peer entity and the apply points

name: transform
description: The pose of an entity: Transform, the derived GlobalTransform and propagating it down the kernel's parent hierarchy

name: camera
description: Cameras: the settings, the target, perspective and orthographic projections, the 2D and 3D markers, the derived values and the target sizes

name: physics_3d
description: 3D physics without rigid bodies: shapes, poses, the pure ray, contact and shape cast queries, the static box set, the collider and the spatial queries over a World

name: text
description: Fonts, shaping, line breaking, layout and glyph rasterization into an atlas behind the engine's own interface

name: ui
description: The gyo.ui Data Contract (codec, validation, the asset loader), layout with text measured by text, the runtime (focus, controls, the text field) and the draw list

name: input
description: Keyboard, mouse and text input as Messages a backend writes, the state kept from them and the text input request

name: window
description: The window as data: its settings, the Messages a backend writes, the state kept from them and the requests the game writes

name: window_camera
description: Writes the window's size into the camera's target sizes as the main target

name: render
description: What a renderer is asked to draw, as data: RenderCommands (2D and 3D passes) and RenderMeshes and RenderTextures (textures from CPU pixels, ids given here), the drawables an author puts in the source World, the 2D and 3D pipelines and the composing of cameras (transform is for the render-side units' GlobalTransform) from extracted cameras and items to passes, the shaders' HLSL sources and ABI

name: render_world
description: The core of a World that draws: render's data in the World, the extract schedule before the frame (with extractFrom), the Submit and Cleanup stages and the emptying after each frame

name: world_render
description: The source World end of render: registers the drawables (Sprite, Shape2d, Mesh3d, SkinPose, RenderLayers), the cameras' clear and depth settings and the render targets for the render World to extract, and writes the render targets' sizes into the camera's target sizes

name: visibility
description: The source World end of culling: CheckVisibility writes each 3D camera's VisibleEntities from the entities' Aabb, NoFrustumCulling and VisibilityRange (registered by world_render), after the transform propagation and the camera update

name: camera_render
description: Extracts the source World's cameras into the render World each frame (order, target, viewport, projection, view point, clear, layers) and keeps a render target of the render World for each of the source's render targets

name: sprite_render
description: Extracts the source World's sprites and 2D shapes, makes textures of their images and queues them as one 2D pass per 2D camera, back to front by z

name: mesh_render
description: Extracts the source World's Mesh3ds, keeps their model meshes as retained meshes, skins on the CPU and queues one 3D pass per 3D camera

name: world_ui
description: The World end of ui: registers the roots (UiRoot, UiBindings, UiRootState), the UiAction Message, UiInput and UiText; maps input to UiInput, runs each root's runtime in its camera's viewport, composes its draw list and asks for text input while a field is edited

name: ui_render
description: Extracts the source World's UI draw lists and the glyph atlas's changes, makes textures of the atlas pages and the pictures and queues one 2D pass of UI per camera after the camera's own passes
